output.rationale: The goods are glazed porcelain floor tiles, which fall under heading 69.07 ('Ceramic flags and paving, hearth or wall tiles'), provided they are fired after shaping (Chapter 69, Note 1) and are less than 3.2 cm in thickness (Additional U.S. Note 3); the description does not indicate they are thick blocks (69.04) or plastic (39.18).
